定语从句(二):where / when / why: 关系副词 where/when/why 在从句中作状语,先行词分别为地点/时间/原因(reason)。
where = in/at which,先行词为地点名词|when = on/in which,先行词为时间名词|why = for which,先行词只能是 reason|关系副词在从句中作状语;关系代词 which/that 作主语或宾语|判断技巧:从句缺主语/宾语用 which/that,成分完整用 where/when|先行词 way 常用 that/in which 或省略
This is the school where my mother teaches.
column3: 这就是我母亲执教的学校。

定语从句(二):where / when / why: I'll never forget the day when we first met.
column3: 我永远不会忘记我们初遇的那天。

定语从句(二):where / when / why: Nobody knows the reason why he was late.
column3: 没人知道他迟到的原因。

# title: That's the village ___ my father was born.
column4: 从句不缺主宾、缺地点状语,用 where。

# title: Do you remember the day ___ we moved into this house?
column4: 先行词 day,从句缺时间状语,用 when。

# title: The reason ___ she cried is still unknown.
column4: 先行词 reason,缺原因状语用 why。

# title: This is the museum ___ we visited last year.
column4: visited 缺宾语,用关系代词 which。

# title: I'll never forget the days ___ we spent together.
The house ___ roof was damaged has been repaired.
column4: roof 的所有关系用 whose。
